question: For each enrollment, show the client id, the program code and the name of the program.
reply:
```sql
SELECT enrollment.client_id, enrollment.program_code, program.name
FROM enrollment
JOIN program ON enrollment.agency_id = program.agency_id AND enrollment.program_code = program.program_code;
```
